revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - These are nice corrections. The 'nu' in προαν̣α̣φερομένων looks just like the medial 'nu' a few lines earlier in προκειμένην--finalizer: add =PN D. Hagedorn (from photo) to this emendation.

Vote - AcceptText - lin19 the underdotted nu in προαν̣α̣φερομένων is not very clear and is more rounded than is usual in the hand but the following underdotted alpha is almost clear enough that I would be prepared not to underdot it - thus I think the reading far better, particularly as the sense provided is clearer and we do not need to posit an unusual verb for the papyri. lin21 use different syntax to enter the BL correction <:τὰ πάντα νικῶντος|ed|<:τὰ πάντα νικῶντος|alt|καλλινίκου(?):>=BL 11.234:>
